messages:
Ana (Partnerships): Quick sync — partner (Snowbridge Labs) wants a repeatable sandbox pilot that simulates S3 -> Snowflake -> vector DB ingest without sharing prod data. Proposal: LocalStack + Snowbridge adapter + lightweight Qdrant instance. Can we run a 48h field trial they can validate? :calendar:
Samir (Eng): I can spin up LocalStack and the adapter. Need sample schema + size. Target throughput?
Lucy (Partner Eng): They asked for telemetry and schema mapping: want to validate column-to-vec mapping and end-to-end trace. Also need PII scrubbing step.
Ben (SRE): FYI we should cap rates and isolate network egress. I'll provide a terraform snippet for the sandbox infra. Also suggest a short retention window for logs.
Samir (Eng): Quick prototype config below to get LocalStack + qdrant running locally for partner QA:
```yaml
version: '3.7'
services:
  localstack:
    image: localstack/localstack:latest
    ports:
      - "4566:4566"
  qdrant:
    image: qdrant/qdrant:latest
    ports:
      - "6333:6333"
```
Drop sample objects into localstack S3 and run snowbridge adapter pointing at the endpoint.
Lucy (Partner Eng): Acceptance criteria proposal:
- ingest 10k sample docs (mixed size)
- vectorization + storage in Qdrant verified (100% success)
- end-to-end latency median < 350ms for vectorization step
- telemetry traces for each docs (span id correlation)
- PII scrubbed per partner SAFE token
Can legal confirm test data agreement?
Ana (Partnerships): Yep, I'll ping Legal and ask for a short MSA addendum for sandbox testing. Also need marketing ok for logo usage in pilot materials.
DeployBot: Sandbox environment created: sandbox-pt-1738094321 (expires in 72h). Credentials posted in 1Password. :white_check_mark:
Ben (SRE): I'll attach a tiny terraform module and a rate-limit policy. @Samir can you add a small ingest script that emits the trace headers?
Samir (Eng): On it. I'll also add a toggle to fall back to a smaller model/quantized runner if latency > threshold.
Lucy (Partner Eng): Partner asked for a dry-run demo Wed at 10am PT. Can we have a minimal end-to-end happy-path by then?
Ana (Partnerships): Wed 10am PT works if we get the infra up today. Tasks: Samir = infra + ingest script, Ben = terraform + limits, Lucy = acceptance checklist + runbook, Ana = legal + partner comms.
Samir (Eng): I'll aim to have the LocalStack + adapter and ingest script by EOD today.
Ben (SRE): I'll post terraform snippets and a short runbook in the thread when ready.
Lucy (Partner Eng): I'll share sample payloads and a small synthetic PII dataset (scrubbed) in the shared folder: https://redwood-internal.share/sandbox-samples
Ana (Partnerships): Great. If anyone hits blockers ping me and I'll escalate to partner PM. :pray:
